description: News story with kicker, headline, dek, two-author byline, published and updated <time> elements, nine body paragraphs, a pull quote, contributor note, newsletter signup, related-articles list with other bylines, most-read rail and a consent dialog. Carries NewsArticle JSON-LD with UTC timestamps.

schema.headline: string — article headline
schema.publishedAt: datetime — original publication time, as in the page's datetime attribute
schema.section: string — site section the article belongs to

notes: summary is x-derived: it is an inference, so gold is null and scoring skips it (any reasonable summary is acceptable; it must be flagged derived in evidence). publishedAt gold is the visible <time datetime> '2026-09-14T06:30:00-04:00'; the JSON-LD/meta '2026-09-14T10:30:00Z' is the same instant and scores as equal. The updated time (15:12 ET) is a decoy. Authors are the two byline names; 'Priya Nair contributed reporting' is not a byline author, and the related-articles bylines (Daniel Reyes, Lena Fischer, Graham Osei, Maya Okafor) are decoys. Section is 'Climate' (kicker, breadcrumb, JSON-LD articleSection).
